Subject: Approval request: 30% Hosted API concession for MediNova (RDW-8872)

Team —

As discussed on the pipeline review call, MediNova (contact: Elena Park) has returned an RFP response that requires a material concession on Hosted API unit pricing in order to win versus two larger incumbents. Summary: they want a 30% off list rate on token usage for an initial 24-month commitment, estimated avg monthly tokens ~1.8B (ramping to 3B after month 6). Net-new ARR if closed: ~$1.6M in year one, ~$3.2M ARR in steady state; strategic reasons to approve: regional expansion into three US hospital systems, potential marketplace co-sell, and very high product stickiness (large inference volumes, multi-region).

What we are asking for: executive sanction to permit a 30% hosted-API rate concession relative to published list for a 24-month committed contract (minimum monthly commit + overage at agreed unit rate), plus permission to include a short-term onboarding credit (one-time) to offset migration costs. This exceeds the standard deal desk threshold (>20%), so I need an exec approval to proceed.

Attachments: MediNova_MonthlyUsageForecast.xlsx (detailed token forecast and ARR scenarios), RDW-8872_SOW-draft.pdf (draft scope and proposed commit terms). HubSpot deal is linked below.

Key constraints/asks:
- We need a decision within 48 hours to maintain the proposed pricing window with the customer (they close vendor selection this week).
- Approval should include any non-standard terms we require (SOC2 attestation timeline, audit access limits, and data retention clause).

Why 30% vs 25%? Bench: a competitive intelligence note shows the incumbent is offering equivalent economic terms through blended usage credits — our ask is justified by the guaranteed committed volume and the strategic reference value of the account. If we only approve 20–25% they will go back to the incumbents and cite price gap.

Requested next step: please reply with APPROVE 30% or APPROVE conditional (e.g., 30% with legal/finance signoff on the SOW edits), or REJECT so I can negotiate alternatives quickly.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear brief. I like the strategic rationale but want to preserve precedent. Two conditions I would attach to any approval at 30%:
- Legal must include a 90-day SOC2 remediation clause (they must commit to provide current SOC2 Type II within 90 days) or we restrict sensitive data use.
- Finance must secure the minimum monthly commit in contract language with a three-month clawback if they under-deliver vs forecast.

If both are acceptable to the customer, I would support a temporary approval for this opportunity only (i.e., do not publish as a standard rate). Please loop Laura for final sign-off.

Jonas / team —

After reviewing the forecast and the strategic ask, I APPROVE the 30% Hosted API concession for MediNova under the following non-negotiable conditions:
1) 24-month firm commitment with monthly minimums codified in the SOW; three-month clawback language to recover credits if they under-deliver.

3) Onboarding credit capped at $45k; any additional migration assistance will be charged.
4) Deal must be executed via DocuSign and legal must sign the redline provided in RDW-8872_SOW-draft.pdf.

Jonas — you have the green light to present this to Elena and procurement. Please copy legal and finance into the external signature packet and sync with them before sending DocuSign.
